      How to read it
      • The flat treemap wrapped inside itself: box volume is the arrange metric.
      • Each axis is its own metric: the top corner is best on all three, the bottom worst, and each side corner names its one odd axis. Volume is the view's metric.
      • Each box splits 2×2×2 into equal-weight parts, biggest first; only the leaf boxes are drawn, one procedure each, so there are no container boxes. Cubes / Nodes (top left) switches to a dot cloud: one dot per procedure placed by its three metric values, 75% pulled to that spot and 25% toward its call neighbours, so it glides and clusters.
      • Colour is position: x red→cyan, y green→magenta, z blue→yellow; white = most of the metric.
      • Selecting outlines callers orange and callees green; packages and cycles mark blue.
      • Peel hides one box per step in sidebar order: the top handle peels from the best end, the bottom handle from the worst end.
      • Drag spins with momentum · wheel zooms · [ ] peel ten boxes · { } one box, on the handle you last moved · ↑ ↓ walk the list · Esc clears.
